blocks.text: British R&B superstar CRAIG DAVID is coming to MANILA and bringing his highly anticipated “BORN TO DO IT WORLD TOUR” on May 31, 2027 at the Araneta Coliseum. Together with his live band, Craig David will be performing the seminal album ‘Born To Do It’ in its entirety PLUS ALL THE HITS. Tickets go on-sale Saturday, December 5, 12PM via TicketNet.com.ph and TicketNet outlets. Presented by Wilbros Live.
